_readme: Business details used across the whole website. Edit values here, commit, and the site rebuilds automatically. Leave a value empty ("") to hide it. See README.md for the full launch checklist.

brand.name: Veltrix Windows & Doors
brand.tagline: uPVC windows and doors, made to measure and fitted properly.
brand.seoDescription: UK-wide uPVC windows, composite doors and repairs. Free window and door surveys, subject to appointment availability. Get a written quote.
brand.description: Veltrix Windows & Doors handles UK-wide window, door and repair enquiries. When a local fitter is unavailable, a fitter may travel from another area. Survey, travel costs and appointment availability are confirmed for each postcode and job.

chatHours._readme: When the team answers WhatsApp and website chat messages, every day. Use 24:00 for midnight at the end of the day; structured data emits the equivalent next-day 00:00.

forms._readme: Optional. Leave disabled until privacy review and live inbox acceptance test. For Cloudflare native lead receipt set endpoint to /api/leads, provider to Cloudflare D1, and verified Turnstile sitekey. A separate Worker API and D1 migration must already be deployed under the same domain. Existing third-party endpoints retain legacy behaviour.

quoteUpload._readme: Optional. Paste the Google Apps Script web app URL (ends in /exec) from DEPLOY.md step 8. Quote PDFs are then saved to your Google Drive and the WhatsApp message carries a link to the PDF, so the customer only presses Send. Leave empty to keep the old way (the customer saves the PDF and attaches it).
